# Bundled scheduler

`fsrs.mjs` is the unmodified `dist/index.mjs` from npm `ts-fsrs@5.4.2` (FSRS-6), downloaded using `npm pack`. MIT notice: `../licenses/ts-fsrs-MIT.txt`.

Bundling this module keeps the study engine independent of a third-party CDN. Source: https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs . See `../ATTRIBUTION.md` for package integrity and configuration.
